payload.label: Agreed with telling applicants when a council home is unlikely
payload.note: The best supported proposal: 71% agreed, 6% disagreed and 23% were neutral. It covers telling applicants who do not qualify for a priority band that they are, in the council's words, “extremely unlikely to be rehoused” through the scheme, and giving them advice about other housing options. The views were collected during the consultation in November and December 2025 and reported to Cabinet on 11 February 2026.
